messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Bug in data file parsing
parts:
Just a quick note, I've stumbled on a bug in the data file format parsing.  In particular, if you have something like the following:

foo <- 4
loo <- 10

the variable loo will not get parsed correctly.  Rather it will get parsed as "oo".  The beginning 'l' will be dropped.  This is probably due to the logic which is trying to parse the number 4 on the previous line and recognizes a trailing l or L.  Not sure of the correct fix here as I don't really know that code at all and I need to sign off but wanted to alert the media, so to speak.

Cheers,
Marcus

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Bug in data file parsing
parts:
Thanks for the note. You were right that the
problem was consuming 'l' too eagerly. I just
pushed a patch that requires the 'l'/'L' to be
adjacent.

- Bob
